messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout initiated: canary v2.14 -> 10% traffic in us-east-1. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/R-4832 — brief: KV cache tweak + tokenizer fix. /deploy id=R-4832

alex: Noting an early tail-latency uptick in the canary group, p95 +120ms vs baseline. small absolute but rising. anyone else seeing infra noise?

maya: seeing it too. Also 3 OOMs on model-worker pods in canary shard over last 10m. logs: `worker-12 OOM at kv_cache_alloc`

sam: Recommend pause the ramp. Suggest pin canary back to v2.13 while we triage.

lee: Quick pin command: `./infra pin-version --model=stable --version=v2.13 --scope=us-east-1 --target=canary` — ops can run this in ~30s.

alex: Ops, can you do a partial revert for canary only? Keep the rest of the deploybot state as-is. We want minimal blast radius.

ops-bot: Action scheduled: partial pin to v2.13 in us-east-1 canary group at 1893010000 by @ops. ETA ~45s. Will post status when done.

nora: vote: stop and pin. :thumbsup:

maya: agree. will monitor KV eviction/alloc metrics post-pin.

deploy-bot: Partial pin completed: canary traffic reverted to v2.13 in us-east-1. Monitoring shows p95 normalizing and no further OOMs in canary. Release hold until 1893013600 for reevaluation.

alex: Thanks team. I'll add a short note to R-4832 release notes about the canary rollback and open a tiny postmortem with rollback triggers (KV alloc error >= 2 in 10m or p95 > 300ms)
ts_hint: generated for staged rollout coordination thread
